web-guide-idea-16.audience: People who cannot attend a local cultural fair in person.
web-guide-idea-16.offer: Offer a guided visit to a permitted mela, selecting a few crafts or cultural highlights. Viewers benefit from a coherent route through a busy event.
web-guide-idea-16.steps.1: Introduce the fair and stop at a few consenting exhibitors.
web-guide-idea-16.steps.2: Recap favourite discoveries and answer questions away from loudspeakers.
web-guide-idea-16.equipment: A phone, power bank and comfortable carrying grip. A microphone can help in noisy areas.
web-guide-idea-16.returnReason: Cover another craft, regional fair or seasonal edition. Explain what is different before asking people to book again.
web-guide-idea-16.promotion: Use organiser-approved visuals and state which parts of the fair your session covers.
web-guide-idea-16.metadataTitle: Mela Mere Saath — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · Saathum
web-guide-idea-16.metadataDescription: Take viewers through a local fair, craft mela or cultural festival where broadcasting is allowed. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
